title: More community projects in the directory
summary:
The garden got more projects and clearer API guides, while image usage, pricing, and request limits received a closer look.

The project catalog added nine Hacktoberfest apps and eight other submissions, spanning Telegram bots, image tools, an Android app, and a Markdown editor. BeeCoder joined the Vibe Coding listings, and several existing projects received corrected contributor credits.

The API guide now runs from quick start to advanced usage, with expanded Python, JavaScript, and cURL examples for text, images, and audio. The Pollen FAQ also clarifies how key types, free-model limits, and Pollen spending currently work, while keeping planned Front-End Key spending distinct from existing capabilities.

GPT Image tracking now reports actual output-token usage instead of a fixed one-token count. Image-model pricing and the free-or-paid labels for several models were corrected in the registry.
